Trump Polls for New Name for AI, Shifting Stance

Former U.S. President Donald Trump has initiated a poll to select a new name for his AI initiative, considering options like 'Superior Intelligence' and 'Extreme Intelligence'. This move suggests a potential shift in his stance on Artificial Intelligence, having previously referred to it as a 'hoax'. The initiative is also being referred to as 'AI Force'.
